Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-002 is to remain connected to a suitable power supply at all times, to keep it in what appears to be a recharging mode. In case of electrical outage, the emergency barrier between the object and the facility is to be closed and the immediate area evacuated...

Description:: SCP-002 resembles a tumorous, fleshy growth with a volume of roughly 60 m³ (or 2000 ft³)...

Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-003 is to be maintained at a constant temperature of no less than 35°C and ideally kept above 100°C. Personnel who come into physical contact must report for sterilization immediately...

Description:: SCP-003 consists of two components: SCP-003-1 (organic) and SCP-003-2 (technological). SCP-003-1 appears to be made from unknown biological material, resembling a computer motherboard, while SCP-003-2 is a stone tablet with glowing runes...

Special Containment Procedures:: Access to SCP-004-1 and keys SCP-004-2 through -13 is restricted. Only authorized Level 4 personnel may remove items from Site-62. Unauthorized use results in immediate termination...

Description:: SCP-004 consists of a wooden door and twelve keys. Each key opens a dimensional gateway with different spatial and temporal anomalies. Several test subjects vanished upon entering, and others returned with severe psychological trauma...

Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-005 may only be accessed under Level 4 authorization. It must never be used casually or removed from the facility...

Description:: SCP-005 is a universal skeleton key that can unlock any lock, mechanical or digital. Though mundane in appearance, it shows resistance to obscured or hidden locks and may be partially sentient...

Special Containment Procedures:: Personnel interacting with SCP-006 must wear sealed suits and follow strict procedures to prevent exposure. Briefings must mislead personnel on SCP-006's effects...

Description:: SCP-006 is a natural spring that produces a liquid capable of extreme health benefits. DNA repair, tissue regeneration, and immune system boosts are observed in test subjects. The source remains classified, with a disguised chemical plant built around it...
